$comment: Agent-agnostic skill registry. This file is the source of truth for WHICH workflows exist and how they are described. The workflow prose lives in the contract files under system/skills/. Every per-tool adapter (.claude/, .cursor/) and every generated index block is emitted from this file by system/scripts/generate-adapters.py -- never hand-edited. JSON rather than YAML/TOML so the scripts layer keeps running on a bare python3 (no PyYAML, and tomllib is 3.11+).

entries.title: Today
entries.description: Use to set up or refresh today's daily note in the vault root. Seeds the morning briefing, carries forward unchecked tasks, pulls qualifying calendar meetings, and generates the day's interview questions.

entries.title: Close Day
entries.description: Use when today's daily note in the vault root needs to be closed out -- processed, routed to permanent homes, and archived.

entries.title: Intake Extraction Workflow
entries.description: Use this when processing raw items from `+/clippings/`.

entries.title: Vault Synthesis Workflow
entries.description: Use this when turning raw notes, generated briefs, research dumps, audits, stale project material, or high-signal AI conversations into a durable Obsidian synthesis note.
triggers: make a durable note from this

entries.title: Wiki Index Workflow
entries.description: Use this when creating or updating `_index.md` pages for major vault folders.

entries.title: Rock Tumbler Workflow
entries.description: Use this to find and develop interesting ideas without taking authorship away from the owner. Pressure-tests an idea instead of rewriting it.

entries.title: Vault Janitor Workflow
entries.description: Use this for maintenance passes that keep the vault legible without silently rewriting the owner's system.

entries.title: Weekly Review Lens
entries.description: Use this when the owner wants an AI second pass over a week, not an AI-authored weekly digest.

entries.title: Map Maintenance Workflow
entries.description: Use this when the portable AI operating system changes: folder conventions, skill behavior, adapter instructions, assistant preferences, or stale workflow truth.
